lines.text: David was glad when they said, "Let us go to the house of the LORD," and their feet stood in Jerusalem's gates.
Jerusalem is built as a united city, where the tribes go up to give thanks to the name of the LORD.
In Jerusalem the thrones of glory stand, the thrones of the house of David.
David says to pray for the peace of Jerusalem, with prosperity for those who love it and peace within its walls.
David says "Peace be within you" to please the elders, and he seeks Jerusalem's prosperity for the house of the LORD.
